profile.description: Promotes learning of the English language through innovative tools and methods in children studying in regional language schools enabling equal opportunities with their counterparts in private schools
profile.mission: We will solve the chronic legacy problem of English Illiteracy by developing effective, easy-to-use, & economical teaching/learning techniques for teachers & students from regional language schools across India.
profile.vision: An end-state where children from underserved communities can access higher education opportunities of their choice, which to date they couldn’t due to poor English capabilities.

Geographies Served Programs Elementary reading This product enables children with basic alphabet knowledge to learn to read and spell simple English words in their mother tongue within approximately 40 hours. It is designed for teachers and parents who wish to introduce early reading skills to their kids. Additionally, the program offers a vocabulary of more than 1000 words. Advance reading This product is designed for children who can read only simple English words and aims to teach them to read and spell ANY English word through instructions in their mother tongue in approximately 80 hours. It is suitable for both teachers and parents who want to enhance their kids' reading skills. The program offers an opportunity to increase the students’ vocabulary by more than 500+ words. Elementary Comprehension This product implements innovative and straightforward techniques to empower teachers and parents to teach children how to comprehend and construct grammatically correct simple English sentences. This approach is equally effective for older independent learners. Advance Comprehension This product enables the students to finetune the art of comprehending and constructing any English sentence with the easiest and fastest learning method. This approach is equally effective for teachers, parents, and independent older learners. English communication program This program helps students to construct simple English sentences. English exposure program This program consists of daily practice sessions in the form of quizzes. This provides an opportunity for new learners to practice their learning. English skilling program This program helps the students improve their English speaking skills. English learning management system This program is targeted towards beginners. This program helps students use their regional language to understand English words and frame simple sentences in English. Impact Metrics No. of Teachers Registered.
